versions.changelog:
- Updated setup instructions to clarify where to view dashboard data and where to obtain/manage API keys and billing.
- Added links to both official product UI (pipiads.com) and account management (pipispy.com) in the setup section.
- No functional or code changes; documentation only.

- Added a Setup section with instructions on obtaining and setting the API key.
- No changes to core functionality or tools.
- Documentation now includes an explicit onboarding step for new users.

Initial release providing Facebook ad research capabilities via PipiAds.

- Research Facebook ad creatives and Meta Ad Library results with PipiAds adspy and library tools.
- Supports searching by keyword, advertiser, region, engagement, and more.
- Includes tools for deep dives into specific ads, products, advertisers, and store-level analysis.
- Requires a PIPIADS_API_KEY and npm for setup.
- Each API call consumes PipiAds credits; see Cost Awareness for details.
